english.subject: english
english.question_text: “We have finished,” they said. → They said that they ___ finished.
english.explanation:
✅ Ответ: had

🧩 The reporting verb “said” is in the past, so the tense usually moves one step back.

english.subject: english
english.question_text: “I can swim,” he said. → He said that he ___ swim.

english.subject: english
english.question_text: “I will call,” she said. → She said that she ___ call.

english.explanation:
